latest_release.name: v20.1.2
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **telemetry**:
  - Count statusline-only environments without slowing statusline down  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2549 [<samp>(eee6e)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/eee6e44a)
  - Server-render the dashboard with Void and Svelte, and show platform and version shares over time  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2550 [<samp>(9e5c3)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/9e5c38ed)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- **deps**:
  - Update dependency tsrs to v7.1.0-beta.tsrs4  -  in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2540 [<samp>(ed1a0)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/ed1a06a0)
- **grok**:
  - Stop dropping Grok 4.7 Fast usage from cost totals  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2548 [<samp>(9f5f8)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/9f5f8c47)
- **pricing**:
  - Keep billing qwen3-coder-plus at Alibaba's price after its retirement  -  by @ryoppippi [<samp>(e64ea)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/e64eaa50)
- **telemetry**:
  - Show each new aggregate as soon as the daily rollup lands  -  by @ryoppippi in https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/issues/2547 [<samp>(534d1)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/534d1db0)
  - Declare workers.dev and preview URLs off so Void can deploy  -  by @ryoppippi [<samp>(1aa26)</samp>](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/commit/1aa2637d)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/ccusage/ccusage/compare/v20.1.1...v20.1.2)
